nodes.label: Phase 1: All-heads Warmup
nodes.rationale: Trains classification heads while backbone and attention layers are frozen.

nodes.label: Phase 2: Multi-task Fine-tune
nodes.rationale: Unfreezes all layers with differential learning rates and EMA stabilization.

nodes.label: Phase 3: Quantization Aware Training
nodes.rationale: Optional recovery tool for INT8 accuracy drops.

nodes.label: Knowledge Distillation
nodes.rationale: Distills knowledge from a larger teacher (e.g., lite4) into a student (lite2) using KL divergence.
